claims: Director Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) was killed in the NCIS 500th episode after 18 seasons.
Director Leon Vance was shot by a corrupt Army CID agent while defending the agency.
Director Leon Vance ultimately bled out from his injuries.
NCIS 500th episode featured a dreamlike sequence with a young Ducky leading Director Leon Vance to the afterlife.
Director Leon Vance saved NCIS from being dismantled by the Department of Defense, reports USA Today.
Director Leon Vance was confronted by a corrupt CID agent, reports USA Today.
A corrupt CID agent shot Director Leon Vance three times in the chest, reports USA Today.
It initially appeared Director Leon Vance might survive, reports Variety.
It was revealed Director Leon Vance was not wearing a vest, reports Variety.
Director Leon Vance succumbed to his wounds, reports Variety.
Producer Steven D. Binder deemed it the right time for a shocking and spectacular exit during the NCIS 500th episode, notes E! News.
Rocky Carroll stated it was not his decision to leave, according to TVLine.
Rocky Carroll stated he was satisfied with the meaningful, full-circle ending for his character, according to TVLine.
Rocky Carroll confirmed he will return to NCIS in the future to direct more episodes, as stated in an interview with TVLine.
